description: SD5thF is an open research platform and curated database of experimental constraints on spin-dependent fifth forces, also known as spin-dependent exotic interactions. It provides standardized numerical datasets, interactive limit plots, literature-linked metadata, experimental source and sensor classifications, coupling-convention resources, and a versioned machine-readable API for reproducible research and automated scientific workflows.
